mapper.select: SELECT tenant_id,operation_id,subject_id,operation_name,idempotency_key,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref, target_id,error_code,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at, dedup_expires_at,dedup_policy_revision FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='BX-03' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{uploadId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='upload.issued' AND published_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT upload_id FROM object_upload_session s WHERE grant_id=#{grantId} AND subject_id=#{userId} AND purpose='DOCUMENT_BODY' AND created_by=#{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT tenant_id,operation_id,subject_id,operation_name,idempotency_key,request_sha256,state,http_status,response_ref, target_id,error_code,schema_version,schema_manifest_sha256,created_by,created_at,classification,revision,updated_at, dedup_expires_at,dedup_policy_revision FROM operation_record o WHERE subject_id=#{userId} AND operation_name='BX-04' AND idempotency_key=#{key} FOR UPDATE
SELECT payload FROM outbox_event e WHERE event_id=#{eventId} AND aggregate_id=#{artifactId} AND aggregate_revision=1 AND event_type='document.upload.completed' AND published_at IS NULL FOR UPDATE
SELECT locator,quote_hash,raw_text FROM source_chunk c WHERE source_version=#{sourceVersion} AND parse_version=#{parseVersion} AND chunk_id=#{chunkId}
